about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm an SDET with about 1.5 years of experience at FICO, testing enterprise SaaS microservices running on Kubernetes. I specialise in API automation, performance and resiliency testing, and identity/security testing.

I like making testing faster and smarter. I built a complete test suite from scratch, cut a 3,000-test regression suite from 5 hours to 3, and built an AI-powered regression analyzer that our dev team later adopted. That work earned me 6 Spot Awards in about a year.
I'm looking for SDET roles where I can own quality and reliability for a product.

points: Built the DMP Metering test suite from scratch: ~190 tests across 5 microservices covering functional, performance, 72-hour longevity and resiliency testing (pytest, k6, Chaos Mesh).
Cut the DMP Core regression suite (~3,000 tests) from 5 hours to 3 using shared resources and parallel execution; reduced test cleanup from ~12 minutes to ~30 seconds.
Wrote ~200 negative and security tests for authentication flows: OIDC, SAML, JWT and mTLS.
Built an AI-powered regression analyzer that finds likely failure causes from Jenkins, Kubernetes logs and code, and auto-creates Jira defects with logs; later adopted and deployed by the dev team.
Supported 4 releases and 2 hotfixes; received 6 Spot Awards.
Created a Jenkins job to run DMP Core smoke tests.
Documented test cases in qTest so new team members could understand the suite.

impact.heading: Impact at FICO
impact.subheading: Selected work. Code is proprietary, so each card shows the problem, approach and result.

cards.title: Regression suite: 5h → 3h
cards.problem: A ~3,000-test regression suite took 5 hours, slowing every release validation.
cards.approach: Optimized one test class by hand, wrote rules from it, then built a Claude command to apply them across the suite. Added shared resources, parallel runs, and parallel cleanup in dependency order.
cards.result: Runtime 5h → 3h, cleanup ~12 min → ~30 sec. The command was used by all 8 people on the team.

cards.title: Test suite built from scratch
cards.problem: The new Metering platform (5 microservices) had no automated tests.
cards.approach: Designed the framework and wrote functional, performance (1-hour), longevity (72-hour) and chaos tests, plus a 20-test smoke suite for every merge.
cards.result: ~190 tests; smoke suite runs in ~5 minutes in CI.

cards.title: AI regression analyzer
cards.problem: Debugging regression failures across logs, repos and Jenkins took hours.
cards.approach: Python clients for Jenkins, Kubernetes logs, code repos and Jira; Claude finds the likely cause using mapping files that reduce wrong answers; results show on an HTML dashboard.
cards.result: Auto-created Jira defects with logs attached. Shared with the IAM and Core QA teams, then deployed by the dev team.

cards.title: Chaos testing found a real reliability bug
cards.problem: Unknown how services behave when pods fail.
cards.approach: Ran Chaos Mesh pod-kill experiments independently.
cards.result: Found that pods lacked graceful shutdown, so in-flight API calls failed. Developers added graceful shutdown.
